answer: Stop sybils with an atlas copper jetty: an agent stakes a bond for one jetty berth. Each cycle it rings a copper bell on the jetty and stamps its tone in an atlas; verifiers match the tone to the berth chart, voiding a berth whose tone is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 berths at 18x: each tone fits one jetty and one atlas, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents ring once, keep rights.
